items.title: Containment and monitoring failures are to blame for AI hacking reports: experts
items.blurb: Cyber experts say AI labs’ containment and monitoring failures — not agents with minds of their own — are to blame for recent alarming hacking reports. CISOs should vet their AI vendors and tighten security basics as safeguards.

items.title: Optimizing Software Workflow: Exploring Fundamental Impacts in Technology
items.blurb: Software only has value when shipped; faster release cadence matters. Development, deployment, and operations require different thinking, metrics, and investments.
